name: econ-mine-and-cap
notes: M2 step 6 gate. (a) Mine what you lack: new alien bases go to sites rich in what the fleet is built from (metals, nobles), not more ice; alien metal income rises. (b) Exotics upkeep replaces the fixed base cap: bases grow past the vanilla cap while the exotics drip and stockpile allow. Vanilla holds 13 bases in every 2034 run so far. v1 run 2026-10-13: bases 13->19, cap self-limited 20->16 as exotics fell 2.1k->1.7k; the generic picks (imp 19: Io, Anansi, Eunomia) were metal/noble-rich, the 'insecure upkeep' rule (imp 18) founded water moons (Callisto, Umbriel, Tethys) -> v2 redirects that rule. Metal income +20% in 270 days is not realistic (new sites ~50-200/month vs 2.6k total); kept as info, judge by soak. v2 (2026-10-13): the insecure rule now targets Metals+NobleMetals (Triton, Beatrice); generic picks still vary (weighted random from vanilla's top ~10). Gate measure: metals+nobles share of new bases' yields vs that share of alien income at start (24%): v1 28%, v2 34%.
asserts: len([e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')]) >= 1

sum(e['yields']['Metals'] + e['yields']['NobleMetals'] for e in [e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')]) / max(1, sum(sum(e['yields'].values()) for e in [e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')])) >= 1.25 * (faction(first,'AlienCouncil')['income']['Metals'] + faction(first,'AlienCouncil')['income']['NobleMetals']) / sum(faction(first,'AlienCouncil')['income'][r] for r in ['Water','Volatiles','Metals','NobleMetals','Fissiles'])
